crime_highlights: E.M.Q. came up to the living room where he woke up S.C. and asked to kiss her
E.M.Q. wrestled with S.C., leaned into her
The complainant resisted the accused's repeated attempts to touch her
the complainant immediately made her escape from the couch to the bathroom, where she locked the door
rationale_highlights: The pre-sentence report discloses systemic and background factors that may have played a part in bringing him before the Court
The history of intergenerational alcohol abuse in E.M.Q.'s family, his own struggle with alcohol abuse
it should also provide for community supervision, counselling, and treatment to assist E.M.Q. in recovering from his alcohol abuse
note: Mandatory minimum case; Gladue effect limited to shaping community supervision and treatment.

crime_highlights: S.P.H. pushed M.K. and she fell into the closet door, breaking it from its hinges
S.P.H. punched M.K. once in the face
K. saw her mother holding her face, crying, and gagging
M.K. sustained a black eye that lasted for approximately 12 days, a concussion, and other injuries
rationale_highlights: S.P.H. is of aboriginal heritage. That is a significant factor in the sentencing.
The history of abuse and its repercussions going through generations undoubtedly has had an effect on S.P.H., as has his difficult childhood.
note: Court's statement of effect is brief.

crime_highlights: Mr. Cardinal elected to drive because he felt he was the most sober of the group
Mr. Cardinal lost control of the truck and it left the roadway, rolling several times
Mr. Lavallee and Mr. Bateman were ejected from the truck and died at the scene
the truck speed prior to Mr. Cardinal losing control was in the range of 134 to 161 kilometres per hour
an amount twice to three times the legal limit
rationale_highlights: the role played by Mr. Cardinal's Aboriginal background and his particular circumstances
Mr. Cardinal's upbringing, dysfunctional family life and substance abuse issues taken together and put in context explain at least to some degree how this tragedy happened
it must also be proportionate to the degree of his responsibility which is impacted by systemic and background factors
Mr. Cardinal's Aboriginal heritage played a major role in his life with alcohol and drugs
